nodes.name: Project event
nodes.notes: Use this HTTPS production webhook URL when authorizing a subscription. Keep the workflow inactive until configured. A success response follows verification and authorized readback.

parameters.jsCode: const i=$input.first(); const raw=await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(0,'data'); if(raw.length>8192)throw new Error('EVENT_TOO_LARGE'); return [{json:{subscriptionId:'REPLACE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID',rawBody:raw.toString('utf8'),timestamp:i.json.headers['prooftask-timestamp'],signature:i.json.headers['prooftask-signature']}}];

nodes.name: Verify event
nodes.notes: The same scoped agent must own this subscription. Verification fails closed on forged, expired or revoked events.

nodes.name: Return to original workflow
nodes.notes: Connect your existing update node here. Upsert by workflowReference/job ID; retain eventId and highest sequence. Only decisionForSavedSubmission refers to that job. An older or duplicate event never proves a new delivery was accepted.
